QUOTE: **`tool:argpattern`** (has a colon): the part before the first colon is glob-matched against the tool name. The whole pattern is then glob-matched against `tool:argvalue`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, a split at the first colon into a tool part and an argument part, and that a no-colon pattern matches every call to that tool, so it matches on the tool name alone.
